ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the leading edges and distal tips. Significant dark pigmentation clusters are observed at the junction of the peduncle and fluke, with vertical striations extending toward the trailing edge. Sparse, high-contrast dark spots are scattered across the medial white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured interior pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations. Distinctive deep notches and jagged pixel-amplitude variations are concentrated on the outer lateral portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a broad concave curve on the trailing edge, terminating in slightly tapered, upward-swept tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular low-contrast clusters (white/grey) visible near the trailing edge boundaries, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel linear markings (rake marks) on the right lobe oriented diagonally; multiple shorter, unaligned dark linear disruptions visible on the left lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel scarring (rake marks) across both lobes; significant jagged tissue loss/irregularities along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, localized dark 'V' shaped pigment pattern located at the base of the fluke near the center point of the peduncle attachment.
